title: What a prompt is and what prompt engineering is

videos.script: Most people picture a prompt as an order. You tell the model what to do, and it does it. {{order}} That picture explains why a prompt works. It does not explain why a prompt fails. {{fails}} A prompt is the start of a text. The model's reply is the most likely way to go on from it. {{start}} Change one word and the likely continuation changes with it. Change the layout, and the model copies the layout. {{layout}} A chat is the same thing with labels on it. A system part, a user part, and an open space where the model writes. {{chat}} The second half of the lesson is about the word engineering. Not clever phrasing, but a goal you can check. {{goal}} You will take three versions of one prompt and measure each against the same test. {{measure}} The numbers decide which one stays, not the wording you like best. {{decide}}
